name: Bases Checkbox Router
changes: Entering Note type rules (Pro) or Extra columns (Pro) in the view options now shows how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button. The options stay inactive until Pro is on.
tip: When a note has both read and watched, the key that comes first in the saved key order is the one that changes.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Checkbox Router is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
